comps.name: APM Undead
comps.objective: Scale Undead Attack with infinite Gold
comps.tip: Rogers and Privateer pay for the setup; Escapee and Brann can make the Gold infinite and leave later for more Undead. Cycle free cards (Refreshing Anomaly too), then play Bounties with Forsaken Weaver to grow Undead Attack. Aim for a golden Handless Forsaken with Reborn, and feed Snazzy Phantom by destroying Reborn minions with Maw Caster or Disguised Graverobber.
comps.whenToCommit: A Bounty source (Sky Admiral Rogers) + Proud Privateer + Forsaken Weaver

comps.name: Living Azerite
comps.objective: Buff the Elementals in the shop
comps.tip: Living Azerite grows the shop with every spell; Rogers and Privateer pay for many casts. The payoff is as many Arcane Absorptions (Leyline Surfacer's spell) as possible: Brann and Kelp Keeper make them, Balinda doubles them. Wildfire Elemental is the best Elemental to buff.
comps.whenToCommit: Brann Bronzebeard + Living Azerite with a good economy

comps.name: APM Shop Buff
comps.objective: Cast spells, then consume a buffed shop
comps.tip: Needs a huge economy, usually Brann + Rogers + Privateer around turn 9. Buff the shop by cycling Blood Gem buffers, Spell Power buffers and Gem Barrage cards (Veteran Brigand); Blood Gem generators like Fearless Foodie are great to cycle. Felboar or Twisted Wrathguard then eat the big shop again and again. Gatekeeper Amalgam and Devilish Distractor are good targets for targeted spells.

comps.name: Keyword Murlocs
comps.objective: Give Murlocs keywords and buff them
comps.tip: Start putting keywords on one premium Murloc early with Sewer Escapee; Bile Spitter is the best one. Cycle Primalfin Lookout and Hackerfin with Brann, and use Kelp Keeper to repeat a strong Battlecry. Advanced: prepare Bubble Gunners in hand and summon them with a golden Diremuck Forager, or turn into a scam board around a Bile Spitter with every keyword.

comps.name: Tasty Lobster
comps.objective: Trigger Tasty Lobster's Deathrattle to scale
comps.tip: Trigger the Lobster's Deathrattle as often as you can: several Rally minions with Deathstrider and Titus trigger it on every Rally. In the shop, a golden Headhunter Gryphon plus Snarky Shark and Lurking Lionfish trigger it too. Give the Lobster Reborn and Taunt, and the Gryphon Windfury (Sprightly Scarab).
